notes:
Context: Mid-market product org (customer engagement orchestration) evaluating Redwood after 3-week Hosted API pilot. Team moved from hosted experiments -> want Dedicated for predictable latency/cost for in-product chat and reranking.

Highlights from meetings and tech review:
- Hosted API pilot (2026-02-01 -> 2026-02-21) used 'small' gen model for live support assistant; average p95 95ms in hosted region, good quality.
- Business requirement: p95 <= 120ms for chat, <50ms additional cost budget compared to hosted per active user. Very cost-sensitive but wants SLA-ish predictability.
- POC ask: 4-week Dedicated POC with canary rollout plan, fallback routing to hosted variants, and runbook for rollback.
- Canary plan: start at 10% traffic, monitor latency/error rate for 3 days, ramp 10->40->100% unless circuit-break triggers.
- Model variants requested for POC: 13B 8-bit quantized (latency/cost target), 13B fp16 (quality baseline), 7B quant (cheap high-throughput). Want ability to route by latency vs quality.
- Routing/fallback plan: primary region us-east-1, failover us-west-2, tertiary eu-west-1 (for DR). If p95 > 200ms or error rate >2% for 10m, auto-fallback to hosted API variant or alternate model. Rollback automated with canary flag rollback in 5m.
- Security/compliance: require SSO (SAML), audit logging to customer SIEM, customer-managed KMS for key wrap, data residency (US-only) and 1 year log retention. ISO27001 certification proof requested.
- Ops concerns: customer infra team needs sample VPC peering/VPN runbook and network ports. Also need quantization and KV-cache behavior docs for their stateful assistant.
- Pricing: initial pricing deck sent (drive link). Negotiating committed throughput vs blended pay-as-you-go; they prefer committed monthly with burst credits.
- Quote from CTO (Dana Ruiz): 'Priority is predictable latency and predictable cost — we need to hit 120ms p95 or failover. If we can't guarantee that, the business can't move production.'

Notes tone: fragmented action items, some direct quotes, prioritized POC acceptance criteria listed above.
